text:
Nora (People Ops): quick ask  Samir's adoption placement date moved up unexpectedly. he wants to start parental leave earlier than his original LOA start. what paperwork + benefit effects do we need to cover, esp. re: state disability and paid leave stacks?

Elena (Benefits): thanks Nora. adoption is slightly different from birth leave. main items: updated leave start/end dates in the HR portal, adoption placement paperwork (social worker/provider letter or placement agreement), and opt-in for any short-term disability or state paid family leave if applicable in his state.

Samir (NewParent): hey all  placement is next week. i'm in CA. will state PFL apply? i thought CA PFL requires an application and can run concurrently with company parental weeks?

Elena (Benefits): CA PFL can be used for bonding after placement. if you also qualify for SDI/PD, we can coordinate offsets. company parental pay stacks with state benefits up to policy caps; payroll will need dates to calculate supplemental pay.

Mark (Payroll): to avoid retro pay please get updated dates before the payroll cutoff (4 business days). we need: approved leave form, placement docs, and whether you want Redwood supplemental pay to top up state benefit to your normal pay. if you opt-in, we'll run supplemental on the next cycle once state payments are confirmed.

Devika (Eng Manager): coverage ops: i'll post a 1-paragraph handoff and mark oncall swaps. Samir, want me to block your calendar and send OOO?

Samir (NewParent): thanks Devika f91d yes please for OOO and oncall swap. Elena/Mark, i'll upload docs today. quick q: does this change my PTO accruals?

Elena (Benefits): PTO accrual typically pauses while unpaid; if you're on paid company leave accrual continues per plan. since CA PFL is paid by state (and company may top-up), accrual depends on whether payroll shows a paid earnings line. we'll confirm after payroll processes.

Legal (Team): small visa/immigration note  if anyone on leave is in sponsorship or has visa check-ins, loop Legal. leave itself doesn't usually affect status, but travel/home country stays can. Samir pls DM Legal if that's relevant.

Nora (People Ops): checklist for Samir: 1) submit updated leave start date in HR portal; 2) upload adoption placement docs; 3) elect Redwood top-up (yes/no); 4) confirm whether you'll be fully OOO or intermittent; 5) manager to post ramp/handoff. i'll triage once uploaded.

TimeOffBot: Reminder f514 payroll cutoff in 3 business days for pay period ending 1806234800. Upload docs at https://hr.redwood-inference.com/leaves

Samir (NewParent): uploaded placement agreement and selected Redwood top-up. set leave to start 1806234700. i'm choosing full OOO for the first 6 weeks.

Mark (Payroll): received. we'll queue the top-up and confirm state payment timing. if CA PFL retro arrives late, top-up may be held until state confirms but we try to minimize delay.

Elena (Benefits): i'll email Samir a benefits summary (medical, premiums, 401k effects). Samir, if you want 401k deferrals to continue you need to be on paid payroll earnings; we'll note that and confirm match policy.

Devika (Eng Manager): posted the handoff and swapped oncall with Priya. Samir f64c rest up and congrats.

Nora (People Ops): i'll mark this thread as the single source for updates. tag me if anything changes and i'll update Payroll/Benefits/Legal.
